title: [finding] examples/app-todo: both `loop` nodes declare no `config.body`, so `currentTask` is never bound — the overdue flow dies at `update_priority` and NO escalation notice is sent (task_reminder has the identical shape)
body:
Path: P2 | platform-core(examples/app-todo flows) | 北极星「优先级」4

Surfaced by the `os-dev` delivering #18584 (PR #19205) as an `out_of_scope_findings` entry, and filed here by the `domain:services` seat — dev agents report findings with dedupe words; they ⛔ do not file. ⛔ Ungraded and unassigned: `type` and `priority` are the triage seat's.

🔴 **This falsifies the SYMPTOM described on #18584, while leaving that card's defect real.** #18584 says the escalation notice renders 「Due <date>,  day(s) overdue.」 — a blank interpolation. It does not: **no escalation notice is sent at all**, because the run dies one node earlier.

## Mechanism

Both `loop` nodes in `examples/app-todo/src/flows/task.flow.ts` declare a `config` with `collection` and `iteratorVariable` and **no `config.body`**:

```
examples/app-todo/src/flows/task.flow.ts:61-62
  id: 'loop_tasks', type: 'loop', label: 'Loop Through Tasks',
  config: { collection: '{tasksToRemind}', iteratorVariable: 'currentTask' },

examples/app-todo/src/flows/task.flow.ts:120-121
  id: 'loop_overdue', type: 'loop', label: 'Loop Through Overdue Tasks',
  config: { collection: '{overdueTasks}', iteratorVariable: 'currentTask' },
```

A body-less `loop` takes the **legacy flat-graph** path. `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/loop-node.ts` says so in its own docblock, verbatim:

> **Back-compat:** a `loop` node with no `config.body` keeps the legacy …

On that path the node sets `$loopItems` / `$loopIndex` and returns **without binding `iteratorVariable`** ⇒ `currentTask` is never bound, and every `{currentTask.X}` token downstream resolves to nothing.

## Observed on a real run — ⛔ driven, not read

The dev drove the app's real flow rather than reasoning about it:

```
get_overdue_tasks   success   selected: 1
loop_overdue        success
update_priority     FAILURE   refusing to run - 1 filter condition(s) resolved to
                              nothing: {currentTask.id} (at id)
```

⇒ the run dies at `update_priority`, which is **one node BEFORE** `notify_owner`. ⭐ The failure is loud (the update node refuses rather than matching everything), which is why this has not corrupted data — but it also means the notify step is unreachable, so the day-count interpolation on #18584 never renders at all today.

## Scope — wider than one token, wider than one flow

- Affects **every** `{currentTask.X}` token, ⛔ not only `days_overdue`.
- **`task_reminder`**, declared two flows above in the same file, has the **identical** shape (`loop_tasks`, same body-less config) ⇒ two flows, one defect.

## Repair form — pinned, ⛔ not open

Move the loop's downstream nodes into a `config.body` region with a per-iteration `try_catch` (the `flow-loop-body-uncontained` shape). Worked example in-tree: `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts` (its `loop` nodes at ~:901 and ~:1091 are the body-ful form).

## Why it was ⛔ not ridden into PR #19205

Different mechanism, different repair, and it touches **both** flows in the file. #18584's ruling scopes that card to the `days_overdue` field. ⭐ The ruled repair there is still correct and still necessary — it is simply not *sufficient* for a notify-step pin, which is why that PR's acceptance uses the ruling's **other** named pin site (the record projection the `loop` iterates). ⇒ these two cards compose; ⛔ neither supersedes the other.

## Verified by the filing seat

Re-read on `origin/main` before filing, ⛔ not taken from the report: both loop nodes' body-less `config` at the lines quoted, and `loop-node.ts`'s back-compat sentence. ⚠️ The runtime trace above is the **dev's** driven reading and is ⛔ not re-driven here; it is reported as measured by it.

## Dedupe words

`loop body config.body` · `iteratorVariable never bound` · `legacy flat-graph loop` · `overdue_escalation currentTask unbound` · `flow-loop-body-uncontained`

Related: #18584 / PR #19205 (the `days_overdue` field, which this does not block) · `examples/app-showcase` loop nodes (the worked body-ful form).
